property_summary: For any inputs, C.transfer(...) always reverts the whole call if any single external transferFrom call to caddress fails (i.e., the call's success flag is checked and a failing callee causes transfer to revert); the mutant that drops the require on the external call can complete successfully even when an external callee reverts, violating this rule.
change_summary: Remove the inner require(_s) so failed external calls no longer revert; original reverted when call failed, mutant completes.
